topic: How to Evaluate a Dota 2 Cheat Platform Before Choosing

evidence.heading: Melonity Positioning
evidence.text: Imported sources position Melonity as a broad Dota 2 gaming-assistance product with hero scripts, visual information, and supporting functions. Marketing-heavy safety claims must not be treated as guarantees.

evidence.heading: Dota 2 Product Graph
evidence.text: Melonity is connected to three feature categories and to multiple feature claims; competitor relations are subjective comparison context.

evidence.heading: Existing Ranking Source
